name: cpig-67-brep-trim
description: 67 Brep-Trim Field (R6.5 Phase E Batch 1 — Conformality)

setup.vlmDescription: A light-blue rounded rectangular box shape filling the viewport, constrained to a rectangular boundary — not a sphere.
setup.whatItDoes: Clips a source field to the inside of a closed Brep. Internally meshes the Brep, builds a signed-distance field, combines via max(F, brep_SDF). Errors if the Brep is open.
setup.whatYouShouldSee: A light-blue rounded-box — the source field clipped to the Brep volume. Distinguish from Skin Field by the absence of a shell band.

requires.fix: install the Slop yak package; on a dev machine a Release net48 build ships it to the Drive folder GH loads from - check `canary doctor` output for the location actually in use
install the CPig yak package, or on a dev machine build %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% CPig.Grasshopper (net48) and register its output folder in Grasshopper Developer Settings
this test loads a Slop definition from the CANARY_REPO_CPIG repo; check that repo out and point %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% at it (see workloads/tokens.json)
